roles.name: Contributor
roles.description: Grants full access to manage all resources

roles.name: Reader
roles.description: View all resources but cannot make changes

roles.name: EventGrid EventSubscription Reader
roles.description: Read EventGrid event subscriptions

roles.name: EventGrid EventSubscription Contributor
roles.description: Manage EventGrid event subscription operations

roles.name: Azure Event Hubs Data Owner
roles.description: Full access to Azure Event Hubs resources

roles.name: Azure Event Hubs Data Sender
roles.description: Send messages to Azure Event Hubs entities

roles.name: Azure Event Hubs Data Receiver
roles.description: Receive messages from Azure Event Hubs entities

roles.name: Azure Service Bus Data Sender
roles.description: Send access to Azure Service Bus resources

roles.name: Azure Service Bus Data Receiver
roles.description: Receive access to Azure Service Bus resources

roles.name: Virtual Machine Contributor
roles.description: Manage virtual machines but not access to them

roles.name: Virtual Machine User Login
roles.description: View VMs in portal and login as regular user

roles.name: Storage Blob Data Contributor
roles.description: Read, write, and delete Azure Storage containers and blobs

roles.name: Storage Blob Data Reader
roles.description: Read and list Azure Storage containers and blobs

roles.name: Storage Queue Data Contributor
roles.description: Read, write, and delete Azure Storage queues and queue messages

roles.name: Storage Account Contributor
roles.description: Manage storage accounts but not access to them

roles.name: SQL DB Contributor
roles.description: Manage SQL databases but not access to them

roles.name: Key Vault Secrets User
roles.description: Read secret contents

roles.name: Key Vault Certificates Officer
roles.description: Perform any action on certificates except manage permissions

roles.name: Key Vault Crypto User
roles.description: Perform cryptographic operations such as sign, verify, wrap, and unwrap using keys

roles.name: Website Contributor
roles.description: Manage websites but not access to them

roles.name: Function App Contributor
roles.description: Manage function apps but not access to them

roles.name: Durable Task Data Contributor
roles.description: Perform all data access operations for Durable Task Scheduler

roles.name: Durable Task Worker
roles.description: Process orchestrations, activities, and entities in Durable Task Scheduler

roles.name: Durable Task Data Reader
roles.description: Read Durable Task Scheduler data, including orchestrations and entity payloads

roles.name: App Service Contributor
roles.description: Manage app services but not access to them

roles.name: Azure AI Developer
roles.description: Perform common development actions within Azure AI Foundry project or Machine Learning workspace

roles.name: Azure AI User
roles.description: Reader access to AI projects and accounts with data actions for AI project development

roles.name: Cognitive Services OpenAI Contributor
roles.description: Full access to Azure OpenAI including fine-tune, deploy, and generate text

roles.name: Cognitive Services OpenAI User
roles.description: Read access to OpenAI models and deployments with ability to create completions and embeddings

roles.name: Cognitive Services Contributor
roles.description: Create, read, update, delete and manage keys of Cognitive Services

roles.name: App Configuration Data Reader
roles.description: Read access to App Configuration data

roles.name: Redis Cache Contributor
roles.description: Manage Azure Cache for Redis instances but not access to their data
